chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 0302: Ji Ning & Yuchi Xiyue Forge a Vengeance Pact Against the Shaoyan Clan
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning learns the depth of his cousin Yuchi Xiyue's hatred for the Shaoyan clan. They forge a blood oath to one day destroy their ancient enemy, an act of vengeance that will define their future.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 0302: The Vengeance Oath
og_description: A powerful new alliance is forged as two cousins unite in a blood oath to destroy an ancient enemy. The cost of vengeance is measured in generations.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 0302: Ji Ning and Xiyue's Pact of Blood
twitter_description: Ji Ning discovers his cousin's centuries-old vendetta. Together, they swear an oath to destroy the Shaoyan clan, setting the stage for a multi-generational revenge saga.

lore_anchors.definition: Yuchi Xiyue, Ji Ning's elder maternal cousin and the last surviving member of the Yuchi clan alongside her grandfather. She is a princess of the Grand Xia royal clan.
An ancient and powerful tribe that ranks among the top ten forces of the Grand Xia Dynasty, responsible for the near-total annihilation of the Yuchi clan.
The new clan surname Xiyue publicly uses to hide her true identity as a survivor of the Yuchi clan and to protect her future descendants while she plans her revenge.
An assassin dispatched by the Shaoyan clan to kill Ji Ning. He is left completely outmatched and unable to act when Ji Ning leaves with a royal princess's guard.
Elite soldiers of the Grand Xia royal clan, each squad consisting of one Loose Immortal and forty-nine Primal Daoists, capable of forming powerful Dao-soldier formations.
A title for a powerful Celestial Immortal who serves as the patriarch of a major clan. Xiyue's grandfather is one such figure in the Xiamang royal clan.

cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a top-ten ancient tribe in the Grand Xia Dynasty, responsible for massacring Ji Ning's maternal family, the Yuchi clan.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn't Xiyue just attack the Shaoyan clan with her royal guard?
cultural_notes_faq.a: An unprovoked attack by a royal princess on a major tribe would cause political chaos and possibly rebellion among the other feudal lords. She needs a justifiable reason.

She plans to slowly build a new clan (the Zhi clan) in secret, generation by generation, until they grow powerful enough to destroy the Shaoyan clan or create an opportunity for the Xia royal clan to act.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can't the Floating Cloud Immortal kill Ji Ning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Ji Ning is now traveling with Xiyue Commandery Princess, who is protected by a powerful squad of golden-armored imperial guards, making an assassination attempt impossible for him.
